(2012–2014) Foundations

"This era was my entry into the tech world - and into Microsoft's boldest bets."

From the debut of Windows 8 and the first Surface devices to supporting the Office 2013 rollout, I guided in-store strategy and retail attach for Microsoft's hardware and software milestones.

Key Achievements

  • Windows 8 & Surface launch support across retail channels
  • Retail attach strategy for Office 2013
  • Campaign optimizations for PC Accessories
  • Product storytelling & marketing enablement online
